# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root — it holds every rule for this repository (non-negotiables: no real PHI, honest local-only software, clinical semantics that treat a blank as not a zero, keep `main` green; plus architecture, testing, git workflow and docs). Read `docs/HANDOFF.md` for current state and next steps. If anything conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.md` wins.

Start every session from the latest `origin/main` and follow `AGENTS.md` "Development cycle". Commit and push your work before the session ends, and record it in `docs/HANDOFF.md`.
